final: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products), type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg FROM type_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.type_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS mean_avg FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.type_avg) AS avg_type_price, AVG(k.type_avg - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(k.type_avg - m.mean_avg) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.type_avg > m.mean_avg
